Predicates:
BredBack(x) ::: x is a form of artificial selection by the deliberate selective breeding of domestic animals.
SelectiveBreeding(x) ::: x is deliberate selective breeding of domestic animals.
DomesticAnimal(x) ::: x is a domestic animal.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Extinct(x) ::: x is extinct.
Premises:
∀x (BredBack(x) ↔ SelectiveBreeding(x) ∧ DomesticAnimal(x)) ::: Breeding back is a form of artificial selection by the deliberate selective breeding of domestic animals.
∀x (Resemble(x, aurochs) → BredBack(x)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.
Animal(heckCattle) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Animal(aurochs) ::: Aurochs are animals.
Conclusion:
Extinct(aurochs) ::: Aurochs are extinct.
